description_en: Queries the list of serverless jobs based on filter conditions
description_zh: 按照过滤条件查询Serverless作业列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-serverless-jobs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServerlessJobs

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html operation to query the list of regions where E-HPC is supported
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html查询可以使用E-HPC的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示条数。最大值：100，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of serverless job IDs or subtask IDs (array jobs)
parameters.help_zh: Serverless作业ID或子任务ID（数组作业）列表
parameters.name: job_ids

parameters.help_en: The names of the serverless jobs
parameters.name: job_names

parameters.help_en:
The status of the serverless job. Valid values:

All
Pending
Running
Succeeded
Canceled
Failed

Default value: All
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless作业状态。取值范围：

All：所有状态。
Pending: 排队中。
Running：运行中。
Succeeded：已完成。
Canceled：已取消。
Failed：运行失败。

默认值：All
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort the serverless jobs by the job start time. Valid values:

Asc: ascending order.
Desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按照Serverless作业启动时间进行排序。取值范围：

Asc：升序。
Desc：降序
parameters.name: start_order

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort the serverless jobs by the job submission time. Valid values:

Asc: ascending order.
Desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按照Serverless作业提交时间进行排序。取值范围：

Asc：升序。
Desc：降序
parameters.name: submit_order

parameters.help_en:
The earliest time at which the job is submitted.

You can use this parameter to query the job list based on the job submission time
parameters.help_zh:
最早的作业提交时间戳。
用于按照Serverless作业的提交时间范围查询作业列表
parameters.name: submit_time_start

parameters.help_en:
The latest time at which the job is submitted.

You can use this parameter to query the job list based on the job submission time
parameters.help_zh:
最晚的作业提交时间戳。
用于按照Serverless作业的提交时间范围查询作业列表
parameters.name: submit_time_end

EndTime.description_en: The time at which the serverless job ended

IsArrayJob.description_en:
Indicates whether the job is an array job. Valid values:

True: yes
False: no
IsArrayJob.description_zh:
是否是数组作业。可能的值：

True：是数组作业。
False：不是数组作业

JobId.description_en: The ID of the serverless job or the subtask (array job)
JobId.description_zh: Serverless作业ID或子任务ID（数组作业）

JobName.description_en: The name of the serverless job

Priority.description_en: The scheduling priority of the serverless job. Valid values are 0 to 999. A greater value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: Serverless作业的调度优先级。取值范围：0~999，取值越大，优先级越高

Queue.description_en: The name of the queue in which the serverless job is run

StartTime.description_en: The time at which the serverless job started

State.description_en:
The status of the serverless job. Valid values:

Pending
Initing
Running
Succeeded
Canceled
Failed
State.description_zh:
Serverless作业状态。可能的值：

Pending: 排队中。
Initing：初始化中。
Running：运行中。
Succeeded：已完成。
Canceled：已取消。
Failed：运行失败

SubmitTime.description_en: The time at which the serverless job is submitted

User.description_en: The username that is used to run the serverless job

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的本页条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总条数
TotalCount.title_en: TotalCount本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回
TotalCount.title_zh: TotalCount本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回
